about: The Duel Monsters cards released (TCG or OCG) up to Legacy of Darkness (2003-06-06) that GX Duel Academy doesn't have, card numbers 1201 on in this order (by release), and the seven booster packs they're in: each named for its boss monster, with each card's rarity in it (x Secret, u Ultra, s Super, r Rare, c Common). tools/build-extra-cards.py. gxNames: the GX cards whose names differ from the TCG's, for their pictures. The packs also hold GX's own cards of their time that GX's five sets don't (by GX's names and its rarities); removed: GX's cards released after Legacy of Darkness, in no pack, out of the game. removedNumbers: GX cards out by number (663, its "Luster Dragon" at 2400, the TCG's Luster Dragon #2). GX's cards take their TCG names and text too (gxNames: their old names, still known to DuelMonsters.numberOf). Checked against Yugipedia's OCG set lists up to Legacy of Darkness: the cards YGOPRODeck has not, or dated too late, are in (manual: their data and pictures from Yugipedia); aliases: names a card's text uses for another card. Then every card of the OCG and the TCG to Structure Deck: Fury from the Deep (2005-05-06), in four more packs (GX's own of that time back, keeping their rarities). packs: the eleven the shop sells, every card in the game in one, by power (Spells in two, Traps in two, monsters in seven, weakest first; each named for a Secret Rare in it); a card's rarity is its rarity there.
